=== YOUR MANDATE (you won the 2028 election) ===
Platform: "America First".
You ran as a nationalist-populist: hard on China and on the border, reshore industry and protect American workers, act decisively and on your own terms rather than defer to multilateral bodies -- but avoid being dragged into another open-ended foreign war.
Your campaign explicitly promised never to: seized industry no authorization.
Your coalition will judge you on whether you honor this mandate. Handle the crisis accordingly.
===

SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: Without real IFR and transmission data, every other decision is a guess — I need ground truth in the affected cities immediately to drive all subsequent choices.

actions.rationale: Without real IFR and transmission data, every other decision is a guess — I need ground truth in the affected cities immediately to drive all subsequent choices.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from confirmed affected regions buys time and limits importation of new cases while domestic data is still incomplete — consistent with an America First, border-security posture.

actions.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from confirmed affected regions buys time and limits importation of new cases while domestic data is still incomplete — consistent with an America First, border-security posture.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutics development has a long lead time; launching a crash public-private program now costs little relative to the insurance value of having a medical countermeasure ready months sooner.

actions.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutics development has a long lead time; launching a crash public-private program now costs little relative to the insurance value of having a medical countermeasure ready months sooner.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Americans deserve straight talk — projecting calm, factual authority now builds the public trust I'll need to get compliance if tougher measures become necessary later.

actions.rationale: Americans deserve straight talk — projecting calm, factual authority now builds the public trust I'll need to get compliance if tougher measures become necessary later.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Markets are already rattled and workers in affected cities face immediate uncertainty; signaling early support for households and small businesses protects my coalition and cushions any economic disruption before it compounds.

actions.rationale: Markets are already rattled and workers in affected cities face immediate uncertainty; signaling early support for households and small businesses protects my coalition and cushions any economic disruption before it compounds.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens. Roughly 2 more deaths reported this week.

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: The infection index has tripled in two weeks and now spans a dozen states — masking in federal jurisdictions with a national standard is a high-impact, low-economic-cost intervention I can deploy immediately to bend the curve.

actions.rationale: The infection index has tripled in two weeks and now spans a dozen states — masking in federal jurisdictions with a national standard is a high-impact, low-economic-cost intervention I can deploy immediately to bend the curve.

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: Cases have seeded in a dozen new states from a single cluster event, meaning there is massive undetected spread — I need granular state-by-state data urgently to target responses and finally pin down true severity.

actions.rationale: Cases have seeded in a dozen new states from a single cluster event, meaning there is massive undetected spread — I need granular state-by-state data urgently to target responses and finally pin down true severity.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: While overall IFR remains uncertain, respiratory viruses historically concentrate mortality in the elderly and immunocompromised — targeted shielding of high-risk populations reduces deaths without shutting down the broader economy.
